en: Sepia-toned panoramic photograph of a city in a valley, surrounded by mountains. A wide river flows in the foreground with a metal bridge on the left. Dense historic buildings, church towers, and other structures fill the middle ground. Handwritten-style caption text appears along the bottom margin of the image, identifying the scene as a panorama of Trento.
